Question: I want to make all qaza namaz. I want to know can I pray all my qaza namaz instead of sunnet in all prayers. Answer ID: 2091 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1002/1002=J) It is afzal (better) to perform qaza salah (missed prayers) instead of praying nafl (extra prayers), but we should not leave sunnan-e-muakkadah (recommended prayers before and after obligatory salah ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
